project_type: TypeScript Node.js Pi extension / provider package
build_system: npm scripts — npm run check (tsc --noEmit), npm test (vitest run), npm run scan:secrets
test_framework: Vitest 4; test files: *.test.ts at repo root; setupFiles: test-setup.ts (redirects HOME); no conftest
verification_instructions: node_modules is ABSENT in sandbox (INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network). Static analysis only — cannot run tsc or vitest. Verify changes by reading source and test files. No docker build available.
setup_instructions: node_modules absent; cannot install. Work with source files only.
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY — no npm install possible. node_modules absent. Verify via static analysis only. TypeScript compilation cannot be run. Tests cannot be executed.
contribution_requirements: Keep changes minimal and targeted. Fix confirmed issues with regression tests. Describe uncertain findings in PR body rather than changing code. One theme per PR.
key_patterns: All source files are at repo root (no src/ directory). Test files are *.test.ts at root. Export pattern: named exports. Vitest mocking via vi.hoisted(). stream-adapter.ts spawns kiro-cli as separate args array (no shell), passing model.id, resumeId, effort as separate args elements. bridge.ts builds loopback HTTP server with 48-char random token auth. kiro-bridge.ts writes agent profile JSON files. serializeMessage() in stream-adapter.ts serializes Pi messages to XML-tagged prompt blocks.
directory_structure: Flat repo root: all *.ts source + test files at root, docs/ for design docs, probes/ for protocol probe scripts, scripts/ for CI/scanning scripts, .github/workflows/ for CI, .agents/tasks/ for automation task state.
